description.value: Bucksnort's Bar & Grill is a locally owned and operated pub restaurant in Port Alberni known for made-from-scratch cooking and famously generous portions. The menu spans pub classics — wings, poutines, fish and chips, flatbreads, and burgers — alongside a curated selection of craft beers, wines, and ciders sourced from Port Alberni, Vancouver Island, and across BC. It sits on Vancouver Island's cycling corridor and would make a satisfying full-meal stop for cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley.
